run_convert_colqwen2_weights_to_hf: run the conversion script to convert ColQwen2 weights from the original repository to the HuggingFace model format
run_convert_colqwen2_cli: run the CLI to convert a ColQwen2 model to HuggingFace format and push it to the hub
run_convert_colqwen2_with_peft: run the converter to merge PEFT adapter weights from ColQwen2.5 into the base VLM model
run_rename_state_dict_keys: run the key renaming function to transform original state dict keys to the HuggingFace naming convention
run_load_original_state_dict: run the loader to download and load safetensors weights from an original ColQwen2 model repository
